scope: Rear corners of the display cover when seated on the printed tip.
observations: I hope you can see in my photos there that we very clearly have a hole exposed still on the back of the cover, on each side where the cover is just not long enough. I can see in the model we think it's long enough, but clearly something is different here. It would be great if you understand exactly what that is. I think it probably has something to do with the deformation of things. But in any case, I think if we just make the entire faucet display cover a small amount total longer, like don't mess with the shape of things too much. Just let's pull that cover back a bit without losing its current front position. Then I think we can cover that hole pretty well.
